meaning: To use something less than it could be used, so that part of its capacity or value goes to waste.
examples: For decades the city [[underutilized]] its waterfront, leaving miles of shoreline to parking lots and empty warehouses.
Farmers in the region [[underutilize]] sorghum, a drought-tolerant grain, planting it on only a small share of the fields suited to it.

lookalikes.tell: Underutilize means use too little; utilize simply means put to use.
To underutilize something is to use too little of it; to undervalue it is to rate its worth too low.
